mango sticky rice is the best
Mar 2026 • Family
There’s a Thai restaurant that I really like. It’s not overly fancy, but the flavors are so memorable.

My absolute favorite dish there is mango sticky rice. The sticky rice is soft and fragrant with coconut milk, paired with perfectly ripe mango that’s naturally sweet and refreshing. The combination of warm sticky rice and cool mango is just perfect.

Another dish that surprised me is the durian sticky rice. If you love durian, you’ll understand how good this is. The rich, creamy durian flavor mixed with soft sticky rice and coconut milk is incredibly satisfying and a little addictive.

If you enjoy Thai desserts, I think these two are definitely must-try dishes. Sometimes a simple plate of mango sticky rice or durian sticky rice is enough to make the whole evening feel a little better.

Enjoyed our meal
Dec 2019 • Couples
Two of us dined here Saturday night. It's a nice place, clean and fresh. 
We were seated right away, they have plenty of servers working and all were pleasant and helpful.
My partner had seafood noodles and I had the street and sour shrimp. It was all good, didn't really have the spicy kick to it that I like.
Along with rice, spring rolls and two beverages the bill was 536k. 
I like my Thai food a little more spicy but I would recommend it.
